language_task: stack the yellow block on the blue blocks
outcome_evidence: In right_shoulder_cam, the robot approaches and grasps the yellow block in frames 7–20, lifts and transports it in frames 21–29, and positions it over the two blue blocks in frames 30–42. At frame 42, the gripper still surrounds the yellow block; release and an independently supported final stack are not clearly established. Completion is therefore unconfirmed, rather than a visibly failed grasp or placement.
